name: agent-reach
description: Agent Reach (Panniantong/Agent-Reach): internet reach for agents - web pages, YouTube, RSS, GitHub, and (after you set them up) X, Reddit and more. LOKI's `reach` specialist. Install: pipx install https://github.com/Panniantong/agent-reach/archive/main.zip (not the PyPI package of the same name). Social channels need cookies: use a secondary account.
